Unsecured retail personal loan.
Clean unsecured loan without collateral mortgage requirement.
Applicant must be an Indian Resident Citizen.
Minimum applicant age: 21 years.
Maximum age at conclusion of loan is 60 years.
Permanent employees of Govt, Quasi-Govt, Boards, Endowments, and reputed companies.
Minimum 2 years of work experience in confirmed service.
Minimum credit score cutoff: 700 points.
Prime score 750+ qualifies for lowest RBLR spread.

Maximum loan amount under general clean personal loan is Rs. 15.00 Lakhs.
Minimum loan ticket size: Rs. 25,000.
Applicant must maintain a minimum take-home pay of 40% of gross salary after deducting the proposed EMI.

how_derived: Calculated directly from published 40% minimum net take-home pay rule (100% - 40% = 60% maximum permissible debt service capacity).
